cases.name: iran_events
cases.question: How many events happened in Iran in June 2026?

arguments.cypher: MATCH (e:Event)-[:OCCURRED_IN]->(c:Country {iso3: 'IRN'}) WHERE e.date >= date('2026-06-01') AND e.date < date('2026-07-01') RETURN count(e) AS event_count
